sources.title: OpenMed — local-first clinical AI
sources.snippet: OpenMed 2.2.0 · on-device clinical AI Your data. Your model. Your iPhone. OpenMed reads clinical text and removes 55+ PHI types on the hardware you control, so patient data never leaves the device. 2,000+ Apache-2.0 models, 33 model-backed PII languages, state of the art on 10 of 12 biomedical NER benchmarks — and a new release most weeks.

sources.title: Meet OpenMed's Portuguese Clinical PII Model: Privacy-First De ...
sources.snippet: It's a practical tool for anyone building de-identification pipelines for medical data, and it's now available on Modelers.cn, Huawei's Ascend-oriented AI ecosystem platform. Developed by the OpenMed team, this model takes the established BGE-Large encoder architecture and fine-tunes it for sequence labelling of PII in clinical Portuguese.
